title: Galatians Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Galatians 6: restoring the one who falls, bearing one another's burdens, sowing and reaping, and boasting only in the cross.

questions.text: In what spirit should the spiritual restore a man caught in some fault?
questions.explanation: It says those who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to themselves so that they also are not tempted.

answers.text: In a spirit of gentleness
In the fear of the law
With a public rebuke
With silence and fasting

questions.text: What does the chapter say is fulfilled by bearing one another's burdens?
questions.explanation: It says to bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

answers.text: The hope of righteousness
The law of Christ
The promise made to Abraham
The whole counsel of God

questions.text: What does the chapter say each man should do with his own work?
questions.explanation: It says each man should examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself and not in someone else.

answers.text: Compare it with the work of others
Lay it before the whole assembly
Leave it for the Lord alone to weigh
Examine it and boast in himself, not in someone else

questions.text: What should the one who is taught in the word do?
questions.explanation: It says that the one who is taught in the word should share all good things with the one who teaches.

answers.text: Teach the same thing to others
Keep what he has learned to himself
Share all good things with the one who teaches
Write down everything that he hears

questions.text: What does the chapter say about sowing, after warning that God is not mocked?
questions.explanation: It says that whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

answers.text: Whatever a man sows, that he will also reap
A man reaps what others have sown
The sower and the reaper are one
What is sown in secret is lost

questions.text: What will the one who sows to the Spirit reap?
questions.explanation: It says that the one who sows to his own flesh will reap corruption from the flesh, but the one who sows to the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.

answers.text: Peace in this present age
A reward in due season
Honor among the brothers
Eternal life from the Spirit

questions.text: What does the writer point out about how he writes to them?
questions.explanation: He tells them to see with what large letters he writes to them with his own hand.

answers.text: That another wrote the letter for him
That he writes with large letters in his own hand
That he writes in haste before a journey
That he writes the same thing to all assemblies

questions.text: Why do those who want to make a good impression in the flesh compel circumcision?
questions.explanation: It says they compel circumcision just so that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

answers.text: So that the law may be honored
So that the Gentiles may be taught
So that they may not be persecuted for the cross
So that the poor may be remembered

questions.text: In what alone does the writer say he will boast?
questions.explanation: He says far be it from him to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to him.

answers.text: In the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
In the assemblies he has taught
In his own weakness of flesh
In the liberty he received

questions.text: What does the writer say he bears on his body?
questions.explanation: He asks that no one cause him any trouble, for he bears the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on his body.

answers.text: The sign of circumcision
A seal given in Jerusalem
The marks of the Lord Jesus
The scars of his own labor
